title: A receipt line
prompt:
Ms. Gridlock wants receipt lines that look the same every time. Set `line` with an f-string so the program prints `washer: 4 x 0.35 = 1.40`.

Use the names `item`, `qty` and `each` inside the braces. The tests change those values, so typing the words and numbers in by hand will not pass.
hints: An f-string starts with `f` before the quote, and each `{...}` holds a name or a calculation.
Inside the braces, `:.2f` after a value shows it with two decimal places, as in `{each:.2f}`.
explain_after: An f-string puts expressions in braces and accepts a format such as `.2f` after a colon [py-055]. The braces can hold a whole calculation, so `{qty * each:.2f}` works out the total and formats it in one go.
